clips.title: The story
paras: South Gate Pass carries travelers between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Its guarded road links Ironforge with Thelsamar.

South Gate Pass cuts through the Khaz Modan range, joining the high mountains of Dun Morogh to Loch Modan's valley in the east. Stone archways mark the way from the cold slopes into the warmer dwarven heartlands. The road leads toward Thelsamar, carrying mountaineers, couriers, and newly trained adventurers setting out from the capital.

Dwarven mountaineers keep watch at South Gate Outpost, guarding the pass against wild beasts and prowling troggs. The road is safer than the untamed parts of the valley, but hostile wildlife and roving threats still test its approaches. Travelers are advised to stay on the road.
